Game Overview

In One Two Start, the core idea is straightforward: embark on your journey as a rookie runner aiming for 5km. Test your limits with each record-breaking sprint, gaining speed and stamina. Overcome obstacles with jumps and slides, and grab water bottles to keep your momentum. Can you conquer the 5km challenge? Let the race begin!
